Retrieves authorization credentials for an authprovider, or indicates what action needs to be taken to obtain credentials.
operation.description: Retrieves authorization credentials for an authprovider, or indicates what action needs to be taken to obtain credentials. If the `token` field in the response is populated, credential retrieval was successful. If one of the fields in the `status` oneof is populated, further action is required to obtain credentials, such as redirecting the user for consent. View comments on `RetrieveCredentialsResponse` for more information.
